items.title: Bernard Purdie interviewed by Monk Rowe, West Orange, New Jersey, July 30, 2003
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe and we are in West Orange, New Jersey filming for the Jazz Archive at Hamilton College. I’m very pleased to have Bernard Purdie here with me today. Thanks for driving and meeting with me.

ctx.x: He was interviewed in West Orange, New Jersey on July 30, 2003 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
